title: 第48章 庸医，绝对是个庸医！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “没追到的，才叫舔狗。”“那连长这种叫啥？”“叫战狼。”陆阳的话引起新兵们狠狠赞同。如果可以，他们也想当战狼。在部队里抱得美人归，这简直就是人生赢家，光宗耀祖啊！试问，谁不想在服役期间，和兵妹妹来一场轰轰烈烈的恋爱？但陆阳却直接泼了大家一盆冷水：“别想了，就算真碰上了也没戏。”“为啥？”丁腾飞对于自已潇洒的外表还是挺自信的。他在外面恋爱可没少谈，还有许多“PL美眉”抢着认他当干哥哥。所以自认为只要他出手，即便不成，机会也肯定比其他歪瓜裂枣大得多。陆阳看着傻子一样看他：“你以为你的竞争对手，只有我们这些个同年兵？”“不然呢？”“部队尚武，你比得过那些拿过奖章，破过记录的老兵士官吗？”“这......”“还有那些肩膀上扛星星的单身排长，连长，指导员，以及机关干部，他们才是女兵的优先择偶标准。”“靠，这么说，咱就一点儿希望都没有？”孔垄有些不服气，难道他这一身肌肉，拿不出手？陆阳差点儿没笑出来：“适当健身，吸引异性，过度健身吸引同性。”孔垄眼睛瞪的像铜铃一样：“妈的，还真被你说对了！”在健身房里，全是男的加他好友，一个女的都没有！甚至还遇上过变态，想问他买刚训练完的原味臭袜子！见大家有点儿扫兴，陆阳也补充了一句，让大家别气馁。保持自信，不跪不舔，就已经打败很多竞争对手了。只要你愈发优秀，自然会吸引更多的目光聚焦过来，然后爱情事业双丰收。这番话还是挺发人深省的，也让那些之后想要留队的新兵，愈发坚定了要好好干的决心。好好干，职务会升，待遇会涨，爱情也可能会在不经意间降临。话虽如此，但陆阳对此却并不如其他人那般，抱有美好期待和期待。前世他处过对象相过亲，但最终都在结婚问题上，遭遇当头棒喝。“彩礼必须三十八万八，我要的不是钱，是你的一个态度。”“房子必须是市中心，不能小于一百平，还得写我名字。”“结婚以后你的钱是我的钱，我的钱还是我的钱。”现实点没毛病，谁不想给自已多一份保障？陆阳深表理解，但就是觉得，实在没意思。前世，父母为了帮他凑足彩礼钱省吃俭用，桌上几乎瞧不见荤腥。母亲生了病不敢治，最终小病拖成了大病。为了一套婚房，父亲白天工厂上班，晚上偷偷送外卖，最终也累倒了。爱情，但对于两世为人的陆阳而言不是必需品，家人才是最重要的。都重生了，如果满脑子还是情情爱爱那点儿事，那就太可笑了。努力搞事业，考军校，当军官，让爸妈以自已为荣！......新兵复检有条不紊的进行着，和征兵体检流程差不多。这会儿，高峰前脚刚把女友送走，后脚何镇涛就笑眯眯的走上来。“进展挺快嘛，到哪一步了？”“还没正式确认关系呢。”“啊，为啥？”“他哥不同意呗。”“老六他凭啥不同意啊，总不能因为他们连老输给你，就不让自已亲妹妹追寻幸福？”“哎......我这大舅哥，心眼比蚂蚁小，难搞喔！”高峰摘下帽子，用力的挠挠头皮，弄得雪花漫天飞：“你说，我要不要在下回演习对抗里，故意放水让让他，让他稍微赢一把？”何镇涛一副等着瞧好戏的模样：“那你得看看，营长答应不答应。”高峰也是一个头两个大：“算了算了，我再琢磨琢磨吧？不然这回分兵，我多划拉俩好苗子给他，让他乐呵乐呵。”何镇涛哦哟哦哟的嘲笑：“那你可得大出血了，六连长那胃口可大着呢，不是尖子他还不要呢。”高峰摆摆手：“不说这个了，投票结果怎么样？”“还没看呢，这不等你一起呢吗？”“你觉得，周凯东是走是留？”“我哪知道，又不是我的兵！”高峰忍不住骂了一句：“真是养种像种，老六是驴脾气，带出来的兵也跟他一个鸟样！屁大点儿是都放心里，那孬兵还管他干嘛，自生自灭多好？”身为新兵连长，他自然知道周凯东变成这样的原因是什么。归根结底，还得怪那个叫丁腾飞的鸟兵。坏的不彻底，好又学不会，偷个炒面还特么能被人逮到，简直废物点心！“妈的，真是想起来就来火！”“烂泥扶不上墙就算了，还特么毁了一个好班长！”“恨不得待会复检，能查出点儿问题，以身体不适为由直接走退兵流程才好呢！”何镇涛连忙打住：“你这就有点儿过分了，怎么还咒人家呢？谁刚进部队，就知道怎么当兵，就能成为一个好兵？”“十八九岁正是叛逆冲动，做事不计后果的年纪，这个年龄段最容易被歪风邪气影响，走上歧路。”“去年团里比武破纪录那木头木脑的小子，来部队前天天被骂龟儿子，他爹亲口跟我说想过把他溺死在茅坑里，谁知道现在出息了？”“还有你们连那提干排长小郭，入伍那会儿是什么德行，敢和班排长干架。”“现在呢，反而成了你的宝贝疙瘩，成了全团学习的优秀标兵！”高峰哼了一声，却没反驳。的确没有人天生就能当好一个兵。都说部队是个大熔炉，能够改变和影响许多人。意义就在于这里能够给那些迷途，叛逆，孤僻，暴怒的年轻人一次回炉重造，洗心革面的机会。丁腾飞这样的在部队里其实并不算少数，这类人往往长期缺乏管教，是非不分，善恶边界感模糊，且崇尚暴力。放在外头，那就是社会的毒瘤，为治安大队严重打击对象。但到了部队，有一万种办法来收拾他们，帮助他们树立正确的价值观，人生观，引上正轨。并将为人民服务这五个字，以及敢于为祖国和人民抛头颅洒热血的红色信仰，刻入他们的骨头里。至于，先前指导员提起的那个提干排长，叫郭永文。曾经干的事比丁腾飞还要恶劣，但最终还是被部队打磨成了一块好钢。不仅在演习和比武中表现突出，为连队夺得许多荣誉；还在抗洪抢险任务里不顾自身安危，一次次累倒在第一线。最终，成功挽救许多老百姓的生命财产安全，被师里授予个人二等功勋章，成为全团学习楷模！这个兵，是高峰的骄傲。而他准备将陆阳，打造成七连的第二个骄傲！尽管丁腾飞和郭永文有点儿像，高峰不觉得这家伙能够成为第二个郭永文！但陆阳不一样，除了身体素质差了点儿，其他方面挑不出一丁点儿毛病来，进步空间巨大潜力十足。很少有那种新兵，是你看一眼就喜欢，就想跟你多说点儿话的，陆阳恰好就是这样的。尤其是，当高峰得知陆阳拖着病殃殃的身体，还在关心班里的事儿，就知道他是个能扛事的主儿。有情有义，有责任心，踏实努力肯吃苦，简直就是每一个连长的梦中情兵！“扯远了，赶紧拆开看看吧。”“好。”何镇涛掏出口袋里的纸条。一张张拆开，映入眼帘的都是一个个“×”。这让二人倍感诧异，似乎也有点儿低估了周凯东在大家心目中的地位？“还剩最后一张了？”“这张皱巴巴的，应该是丁腾飞的，还拆吗？”此时的二人都有点儿犹豫，似乎不大想拆最后这个。准确的说，是不希望拆开后，看到的是一个“√”。因为前头这些，足以说明周凯东在大家心目中，依旧是一位称职的班长。经过陆阳的开导，周凯东也及时调整好了状态，并拿出以前练兵的气势。所以，这还真有点儿骑虎难下，不大好弄......就在二人纠结时，陆陆续续有新兵体检完，拿着体检单走出来。“怎么样，没问题吗？”周凯东在外头台阶旁等着，出来一个人就收一张体检单。“班长，说出来你都不信，我掉了整整七斤！”“还得减，我预计你至少减十斤。”“班长，我还长高了一点五厘米，入伍之前明明是169，现在成170.5了！”“作息规律，营养均衡，再加运动锻炼，会长高不奇怪；多喝点儿牛奶，后头还能再窜一窜。”周凯东整了整手上单子，发现还少了个人，于是询问陆阳怎么还没出来？孔垄：“不知道啊，先前测视力那会儿排在我后头的？”“你去看看。”“好。”孔垄来到先前检查视力那间屋子，发现里三层外三层的挤满了人。周凯东发现情况不对，赶紧带着班上的人一块往里挤。......此时屋内，陆阳满头虚汗的坐在椅子上，正在被面前一位穿白大褂，戴着厚厚眼镜片的中年女医生“刁难”。“这是几？”“6。”“不对！”“8？”“这里头有三个数！”陆阳眼睛死死盯着面前色卡，手心已经汗湿了。可不论如何努力，他只能找到两个数字，怎么都找不出第三个。女医生皱着眉头，换了一张色卡，陆阳依旧没法彻底认清。接连试了几次，她最终无奈的摇头，并将陆阳的体检表推了回去。看着从人群里焦急挤进来的老兵士官周凯东，女医生摘下眼镜问道。“你是他班长？”“对，我是。”“你的这个兵，色弱，我没法儿给他盖章。”“不会吧？”周凯东满脸不可置信。女医生一脸严肃的看着陆阳，显然是把他当成那种体检不合格，塞钱找关系混进来的。“我不知道你之前是怎么通过征兵体检的，但在我这想蒙混过关，想都别想。”“按照部队征兵条例，色盲色弱是肯定不符合条件的，不能留在部队的。”“你最好有个心理准备，很可能会因为身体问题，被退兵处理！”门口走廊上，高峰和何镇涛二人听到这话，当即暴跳如雷！开特么什么国际玩笑？庸医，绝对是个庸医！
content_en: "Those who haven't been caught are called licking dogs." "What do you call a company commander?" "He's called a warrior wolf." Lu Yang's words aroused strong agreement from the recruits.If possible, they would also like to be wolf warriors.To win a beautiful woman in the army is to be a winner in life and to honor one's ancestors!Let me ask, who doesn’t want to have a vigorous love affair with a soldier’s sister during the military service?But Lu Yang directly poured cold water on everyone: "Don't think about it, it won't work even if you meet him." "Why?" Ding Tengfei is quite confident in his chic appearance.He talks a lot about love outside, and there are many "PL girls" rushing to recognize him as their brother.So I think that as long as he takes action, even if it fails, the chance will definitely be much greater than other crooked melons and jujubes.Lu Yang looked at him like a fool: "Do you think your competitors are only soldiers of the same age like us?" "What else?" "The army is good at martial arts. Can you compare to those veteran non-commissioned officers who have won medals and broken records?" "This..." "And that?Those single platoon commanders, company commanders, instructors, and agency cadres who carry stars on their shoulders are the first choice for female soldiers."" Damn, so we have no hope at all?" Kong Long was a little unconvinced. Could it be that he couldn't use his muscles?Lu Yang almost didn't laugh: "Proper exercise will attract the opposite sex, and excessive exercise will attract the same sex." Kong Long's eyes widened like bells: "Damn, you were right!" In the gym, all the men were friends with him, and there was not a single woman!I even met a pervert and wanted to ask him to buy original smelly socks just after training!Seeing that everyone was a little disappointed, Lu Yang also added, telling everyone not to be discouraged.If you stay confident and don't kneel or lick, you will have defeated many competitors.As long as you become better and better, you will naturally attract more attention, and then you will have a good harvest in love and career.These words are quite thought-provoking, and they also make those recruits who want to stay in the team more determined to do a good job.If you work hard, your position will be promoted, your salary will increase, and love may come unexpectedly.Having said that, Lu Yang did not have good expectations and expectations for this like others.In his previous life, he had gone on blind dates with people, but in the end they all faced a blow when it came to marriage."The bride price must be 388,000 yuan. What I want is not money, but your attitude." "The house must be in the city center, not less than 100 square meters, and it must have my name on it." "After you get married, your money is my money, and it is still my money." There is nothing wrong with being realistic. Who doesn't want to give themselves more protection?Lu Yang understood deeply, but he just felt that it was really boring.In his previous life, his parents were frugal in order to help him raise enough money for gifts, so there was almost no meat on the table.My mother didn't dare to treat her illness, and eventually the minor illness turned into a serious one.In order to get a wedding house, my father worked in a factory during the day and secretly delivered food at night. In the end, he collapsed from exhaustion.Love is not a necessity for Lu Yang, who has lived in two generations. Family is the most important thing.Even though we have been reborn, it would be ridiculous if our minds are still filled with love and love.Work hard to build a career, go to the military academy, become an officer, and make your parents proud of you!...The re-examination of new recruits is proceeding in an orderly manner, similar to the process of military recruitment physical examination.At this moment, Gao Feng had just sent his girlfriend away, and He Zhentao walked up with a smile on his back."It's progressing very fast. How far are we?" "The relationship hasn't been officially confirmed yet." "Ah, why?" "His brother doesn't agree." "Why does he disagree with the sixth brother? You can't stop your own sister from pursuing happiness just because they lost to you in old age?" "Hey... I am a brother-in-law who has a smaller mind than an ant. It's difficult to deal with!" Gao Feng took off his hat!He scratched his scalp so hard that snowflakes flew all over the sky: "Tell me, should I deliberately let him down in the next exercise confrontation and let him win a little bit?" He Zhentao looked like he was waiting for a good show: "Then you have to see if the battalion commander agrees or not." Gao Feng was also the first to say: "Forget it, let me think about it again? Otherwise this timeDivide the troops and give him two more good ones to make him happy." He Zhentao laughed: "Then you are going to have a big appetite.He is not a top man and he doesn't want it." Gao Feng waved his hand and said, "Don't talk about it.What's the result of the vote?" "I haven't seen it yet.Don't you think I can join you?"Should I leave or stay?" "I don't know, they are not my soldiers!" Gao Feng couldn't help but cursed: "You are really a bastard, the sixth man has a donkey temper, and the soldiers he brings out are just like him!If you don't care, why should you care about him?How can he just fend for himself?" As a new company commander, he naturally knew the reason why Zhou Kaidong became like this.In the final analysis, the bird soldier named Ding Tengfei has to be blamed.The bad ones are incomplete, the good ones can’t be learned, and you can get caught stealing fried noodles. It’s a useless snack!"Damn, it really makes me angry just thinking about it!" "It doesn't matter if the mud can't hold up the wall, it ruined a good squad leader!" "I can't wait for a re-examination later to find out some problems, so I can just go through the withdrawal process on the grounds of physical discomfort!" He ZhenTao quickly stopped: "You are going a bit too far, why are you still cursing others? Who just joins the army and knows how to be a soldier, can he become a good soldier?" "Eighteen or nineteen years old is the age when you are rebellious and impulsive, and do things recklessly. This age groupHe is most likely to be influenced by unhealthy tendencies and go astray."The stupid boy who broke the record in the competition last year was called a son of a bitch every day before he came to the army. His father told me personally that he thought of drowning him in a latrine. Who knew he would be successful now?"And your company's platoon leader Xiao Guo, what kind of character did he have when he joined the army?""Now, he has become your darling and an excellent model for the whole regiment to learn from!"Gao Feng snorted, but did not refute.It is true that no one is born to be a good soldier.It is said that the military is a melting pot that can change and influence many people.The significance is that this place can give those lost, rebellious, withdrawn, and angry young people a chance to reinvent themselves and change their minds.People like Ding Tengfei are actually not a minority in the army. Such people often lack discipline for a long time, do not distinguish between right and wrong, have a vague sense of the boundaries between good and evil, and advocate violence.Outside, they are a cancer in society, and they are the targets of serious attack by the security brigade.But when they get to the army, there are ten thousand ways to deal with them, help them establish correct values ​​and outlook on life, and get them on the right track.And the five words of serving the people, as well as the red faith of daring to shed one's life and blood for the motherland and the people, will be engraved into their bones.As for the platoon leader mentioned by the instructor earlier, his name is Guo Yongwen.He once did worse things than Ding Tengfei, but in the end he was polished into a good piece of steel by the army.Not only did he perform outstandingly in exercises and competitions, winning many honors for the company; he also disregarded his own safety during flood fighting and rescue missions, and fell exhausted on the front line again and again.In the end, he successfully saved the lives and property of many people, and was awarded the second-class personal merit medal by the division, becoming a model for the entire regiment!This soldier is the pride of Gaofeng.And he plans to make Lu Yang the second pride of the Seventh Company!Although Ding Tengfei and Guo Yongwen are somewhat similar, Gao Feng doesn't think this guy can become the second Guo Yongwen!But Lu Yang is different. Apart from his poor physical fitness, he can't find any faults in other aspects. There is huge room for improvement and full potential.There are very few recruits that you like at first sight and want to talk to you more. Lu Yang happens to be like this.Especially, when Gao Feng learned that Lu Yang was still caring about the class despite his illness, he knew that he was a capable master.Loving and righteous, responsible, hard-working and willing to endure hardships, he is simply every company commander’s dream soldier!"That's too far. Let's quickly open it and take a look." "Okay." He Zhentao took out the note from his pocket.Opening them one by one, all you see are "X"s.This surprised the two of them, and they seemed to have underestimated Zhou Kaidong's status in everyone's mind?"Is there the last one left?" "This wrinkled one should be Ding Tengfei's. Do you still want to open it?" At this time, the two of them were a little hesitant and didn't seem to want to open the last one.To be precise, I don’t want to see a “√” after taking it apart.Because the above is enough to show that Zhou Kaidong is still a competent monitor in everyone's mind.After Lu Yang's guidance, Zhou Kaidong also adjusted his condition in time and showed the same momentum as in previous training.Therefore, this is really a bit of a dilemma, and it is not easy to handle... Just as the two were struggling, one after another new recruits came out after completing their physical examinations and holding physical examination forms."How's it going? Are you okay?" Zhou Kaidong waited outside on the steps and collected a physical examination form for each person who came out."Squad leader, you won't believe it when I tell you. I lost a full seven pounds!" "I still have to lose weight. I expect you to lose at least ten pounds." "Squad leader, I have grown 1.5 centimeters taller. I was 169 before joining the army, but now I am 170.5!""Regular work and rest, balanced nutrition, plus exercise, it's not surprising that you will grow taller; drink more milk, and you can run around again." Zhou Kaidong adjusted the list on his hand and found that there was one person missing, so he asked Lu Yang why he hadn't come out yet?Kong Long: "I don't know. Who was behind me when the eyesight test was done earlier?" "Go and have a look." "Okay." Kong Long came to the room where the eyesight was checked earlier and found that the three floors inside and outside were crowded with people.Zhou Kaidong realized that something was wrong and quickly squeezed in with everyone in his class....At this time, Lu Yang was sitting on a chair in the room with sweat on his head, being "made difficult" by a middle-aged female doctor in front of him who was wearing a white coat and thick glasses."What is this?" "6." "That's wrong!" "8?" "There are three numbers here!" Lu Yang stared at the color card in front of him, and his palms were already wet with sweat.But no matter how hard he tried, he could only find two numbers, and he couldn't find the third one.The female doctor frowned and changed the color card, but Lu Yang still couldn't fully recognize it.After trying several times in succession, she finally shook her head helplessly and pushed back Lu Yang's medical examination form.Looking at veteran sergeant Zhou Kaidong who was anxiously squeezing in from the crowd, the female doctor took off her glasses and asked."Are you his squad leader?" "Yes, I am." "This soldier of yours is so weak that I can't stamp him." "No way?" Zhou Kaidong looked in disbelief.The female doctor looked at Lu Yang seriously, obviously thinking that he was the kind of person who failed the physical examination and slipped in money to find connections."I don't know how you passed the military recruitment physical examination before, but if you want to get through, don't even think about it." "According to the army recruitment regulations, color blindness and color weakness are definitely ineligible and cannot stay in the army." "You'd better be mentally prepared, it is very likely that you will be discharged from the army due to physical problems!" In the corridor at the door, Gao Feng and He Zhentao heard this and immediately became furious!What kind of international joke are you kidding?A quack, definitely a quack!
